parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ (() => { const p = $items('Prepare Graph Payload')[0].json; const stmts = (p.cleanupStatements || []).map(s => ({ statement: s.statement, parameters: s.parameters })); stmts.push({ statement: p.cypher }); stmts.push({ statement: p.postProcess, parameters: { project: p.project_name } }); stmts.push({ statement: p.descriptionStatement, parameters: { project: p.project_name, description: p.rules_text || '' } }); return { statements: stmts }; })() }}
